main.description: Renders Markdown to HTML with the renderer the pages draw comments, issue and pull bodies with: raw HTML shown as text, bare web addresses made links, and relative links resolved inside the repository. Reads and fetches nothing, and needs no login. A procedure rather than a query, since the text may be long.

repo.description: The dev.knotless.repo record of the repository it is written in, as dev.knotless.getThread takes it: relative links resolve inside it. Without it, they resolve from the site's root.

text.description: The Markdown, as long as a comment's or a body's may be.

html.description: The HTML, as dev.knotless.getThread's comments carry it.

description: Markdown as this appview's pages show it once posted, for a preview of what is being written.
